verdict.rationale: Temporal is a workflow orchestration platform, so exposing workflows as MCP tools for external agents is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server, MCP tool exposure, or any way to publish workflows as agent-callable tools. The AI integrations it does document (Google ADK, Vercel AI SDK, AgentCore workers) are about orchestrating agents inside Temporal, not serving workflows to external agents.
